sources.entry: stts - macOS app for monitoring the status of cloud services.

summary.one_liner: stts is a macOS menubar app that shows the status of cloud services and notifies you when a service goes down or is restored.
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the macOS menubar; one click shows the current status of the services you follow. It can send notifications when a service goes down or comes back up. A single click opens that service's status page. The README describes it as deliberately unobtrusive, showing only the status information. Services are added through an included extract script (run with Ruby via Bundler), and services the script cannot handle can be requested by opening an issue. The README says the app is available on the Mac App Store.
use_cases: get notified when a service goes down
check status of web services from the menubar
open a service's status page quickly
track uptime of services I depend on
notable: Lives in the macOS menubar with one-click status view
Notifications when services go down or are restored
Extract script adds most services automatically
One click opens the service's status page
Available on the Mac App Store
caveats: Services the extract script cannot handle must be requested through an issue
README does not describe the license or details of the Mac App Store listing beyond its availability
keywords: get alerted when website is down
